title: Dealer and Service Visit References
summary: This topic is mostly made up of procedural mentions of scheduling, advising, or planning dealer and service visits, with very little explicit sentiment about the visit itself.

positive.summary: One positive review describes the customer wanting to return to the dealership for another hands-on tutorial.

negative.summary: One negative review describes a manual dealer update being needed because of a known eSIM activation issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention planned, scheduled, or advised dealer visits without enough evaluative detail to infer clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and describe administrative or procedural visit references rather than opinions about dealer service quality.
The examples mix several contexts, including scheduling, troubleshooting, loaner availability, inspections, and follow-up advice, so the topic is only loosely coherent.
Known sentiment examples are very limited, so the sentiment summaries rely on sparse evidence.
